section: noncomputable section; open Set; namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex

owned_definitions.sourceHinge: def sourceHinge (z x : E) : EReal := ((max (1 - inner ℝ z x) 0 : ℝ) : EReal)
owned_definitions.hingeFamily:
def hingeFamily (z : E) (i : Bool) (y : E) : EReal :=
  ((inner ℝ (if i then -z else 0) y + (if i then 1 else 0) : ℝ) : EReal)

SourceSubdifferential.body:
def SourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | ∀ y, f x + (inner ℝ g (y - x) : EReal) ≤ f y}

SourceProper.body:
def SourceProper (f : E → EReal) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) ∧ ∃ x, ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)

effectiveDomain.body: def effectiveDomain (f : E → EReal) : Set E := {x | f x < ⊤}

realEpigraph.body: def realEpigraph (f : E → EReal) : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}

IsConvexExtended.body: def IsConvexExtended (f : E → EReal) : Prop := Convex ℝ (realEpigraph f)

SourceFiniteMax.body:
def SourceFiniteMax {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (f : ι → E → EReal) (x : E) : EReal := by
  classical
  exact Finset.univ.sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i => f i x)
